scope: Receipt published but finalized event missing: detection and verified event-only recovery

finding.before: Receipt without finalized event reported complete and repeated finalize never repaired the missing event.
finding.after: Status complete=false with finalization_event pending; retry finalize revalidates receipt and all evidence/audits before appending missing event only.

validation.red_regression: Event failure fixtures previously reported complete=true.
validation.real_cli: Kill immediately after receipt hard-link publication, then CLI status incomplete; retry succeeds and only run-state.json changes.
additional_tests: tampered report rejects recovery without writes
repeated finalize after recovery changes no files

independent_review.additional_probes: At event capacity, initial/recovery finalize rejects unchanged; already complete sealed finalize remains idempotent. Reviewer-reported temporary fixtures.

limits: Only finalized-event recovery implemented; other transactions remain PARTIAL.
Receipt staging hard link left by kill remains unchanged; no orphan cleanup.
Event presence does not prove payload authenticity or historical event details.
No Windows, network filesystem or power-loss durability acceptance.
No live provider, app, commit, push or release.
